'''W3''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], that accompanied [[Jao Assam]] in a [[Unidentified Galactic Triumvirate starfighter|starfighter]] on his mission to the [[Carreras system/Legends|Carreras system]] in [[138 ABY]].<ref name="Legacy 1" />
